# sophosfirewall_ips_policy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing IPS policy by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a built-in policy, e.g. to attach it to a firewall rule.
data "sophosfirewall_ips_policy" "general" {
  name = "generalpolicy"
}

output "general_policy_rules" {
  value = data.sophosfirewall_ips_policy.general.rules[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the IPS policy. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules of the policy, evaluated in order. Each rule selects signatures either by filters (`categories`, `severities`, `platforms`, `targets`, `smart_filter`, `additional_filters`; a signature must match every configured filter) or by name (`signatures`), not both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action for traffic matching a selected signature. `recommended` uses the action Sophos recommends for each signature, `disable` turns the signatures off. One of `recommended`, `allowPacket`, `dropPacket`, `disable`, `dropSession`, `reset`, `bypassSession`. Defaults to `recommended`.
- `additional_filters` (Map of Set of String) Filters on further signature attributes, as a map from attribute key to the values to select, for attributes the firewall lists beyond category, severity, platform and target. Use the dedicated attributes for those.
- `categories` (Set of String) Signature categories to select, e.g. `browser-ie`. The values are those listed for the attribute by `GET /intrusion-prevention/signature-attributes` on the firewall and are passed through verbatim, as they depend on the installed signature pattern.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule, unique within the policy.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms to select, e.g. `Windows` or `Linux`. The values are those listed for the attribute by `GET /intrusion-prevention/signature-attributes` on the firewall and are passed through verbatim, as they depend on the installed signature pattern.
- `severities` (Set of String) Signature severities to select, e.g. `Critical` or `Major`. The values are those listed for the attribute by `GET /intrusion-prevention/signature-attributes` on the firewall and are passed through verbatim, as they depend on the installed signature pattern.
- `signature_source` (String) Signatures the rule selects from: the Sophos signature pattern (`default`) or custom signatures (`custom`). One of `default`, `custom`. Defaults to `default`.
- `signatures` (Set of String) Names of individual signatures to select, e.g. `SERVER-ORACLE Oracle WebLogic Server CVE-2018-2894`. Conflicts with the filter attributes.
- `smart_filter` (Set of String) Select signatures whose name contains any of these texts, e.g. `CVE-2021-44228` (*Smart filter* in the web admin console).
- `targets` (Set of String) Targets to select: `Client`, `Server` or both. The values are those listed for the attribute by `GET /intrusion-prevention/signature-attributes` on the firewall and are passed through verbatim, as they depend on the installed signature pattern.
